title: M3Exam: A Multilingual, Multimodal, Multilevel Benchmark for Examining Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance across 9 diverse languages (varying in resource availability and script) using native, non-translated human exam questions to measure performance disparities and English-centric advantages.

Sourcing real, official exam questions directly from different countries to test whether models can understand culturally specific and unique concepts natively, rather than relying on translated English datasets that introduce Western/English-centric bias.
